summary: AC1 PASS: php -l on Parser.php (and all src/SimpleHtmlDom/*.php files) returns zero parse errors.
AC2 PASS: No phpstan or psalm configured in composer.json or project root — 0 new static analysis errors by definition.
AC3 PASS: Full PHPUnit suite — 274 tests, 1174 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 risky tests (PHP 8.5.4 / PHPUnit 12.5.14).

AC4 PASS: Public API surface is unchanged. All old camelCase private method names (parseDoubleQuotedAttr, parseSingleQuotedAttr, parseUnquotedAttr, parseSelector, isUtf8) return zero grep matches in src/ and tests/. The three private Parser.php methods are now correctly snake_case. The DOM delegate block (childNodes, firstChild, lastChild, createElement, createTextNode, getElementById, getElementsById, getElementByTagName, getElementsByTagName, loadFile) and all other public methods are untouched.
Edge-case checks: src/simple_html_dom.php passes php -l. Zero stale camelCase references remain anywhere in the test suite.

comments.note: No phpstan or psalm tool configured — AC2 passes vacuously. Adding phpstan to the dev dependencies would provide ongoing type-safety guarantees for future refactoring passes.

SelectorParser::parse_selector() still uses the camelCase parameter name $selectorString (carried forward from WP-002 code review). PHP positional call-sites are unaffected, but a future parameter-name sweep could rename to $selector_string for full snake_case consistency.
No blocking issues found. All renamed methods were private; the test suite acts as a complete regression guard for observable behaviour and all 274 tests pass.

notes: All four acceptance criteria verified and met. 274/274 tests pass with zero regressions. No public API methods were renamed. The naming convention sweep (WP-001 + WP-002) is fully regression-free and ready for documentation.
